title.zh-TW: 遠端控制啟動時會改用空著的連接埠
title.en: Remote control now finds an open port when starting

body.zh-TW: 要以 `--remote-control` 開啟遠端控制（remote control，讓另一端連入操作的功能）時，連接埠若已有人使用，工具原本會拒絕啟動。現在它會請作業系統提供可用的連接埠。⟦這像計程車到停靠處發現已有車佔著，不必取消行程，而是由調度員帶它去空位。⟧ 對需要啟動遠端控制的人來說，連接埠被占用不再直接使它無法開始。
body.en: When you start remote control with `--remote-control`, the tool used to refuse to start if its port was already taken. It now asks the operating system for an available port. ⟦It is like a taxi reaching its stand, finding another cab there, and being directed to an open space instead of cancelling the trip.⟧ A taken port no longer stops remote control from getting started.

items.original: Fixed `--remote-control` refusing to start whenever port was taken, so it now takes a free port from the operating system.

title.zh-TW: 終端機太窄時可隱藏開頭標誌圖案
title.en: Hide banner art when it gets in the way

body.zh-TW: 在窄終端機查看輸出、用螢幕閱讀器讀內容或準備錄影時，若開頭橫幅的標誌圖案擋住資訊，設定 `AGY_CLI_HIDE_LOGO`。這個環境變數（程式在啟動時收到的設定）會在這次啟動隱藏橫幅上的標誌圖案，版本和帳號資訊仍會照原樣保留顯示。⟦這像把窄公告欄上佔位的海報取下；版本與帳號資訊仍留著。⟧ 它不會連版本和帳號資訊一起隱藏。
body.en: When banner art blocks information in a narrow terminal, a screen reader, or a recording, set `AGY_CLI_HIDE_LOGO`. This environment variable (a setting passed to a program when it starts) hides the art for that launch. ⟦It is like taking an oversized poster off a cramped noticeboard while leaving the version and account notices in place.⟧ The version and account lines remain visible.

items.original: Added the `AGY_CLI_HIDE_LOGO` environment variable for narrow terminals, screen readers and recordings where the banner's logo art gets in the way; setting it suppresses the art while keeping the version and account lines.

title.zh-TW: 可略過終端機畫面的繪製最佳化
title.en: A switch to bypass terminal rendering optimizations

body.zh-TW: Antigravity 的渲染器（把文字畫到終端機畫面的部分）通常會使用兩項最佳化。它先以 diffing 最佳化（比對新舊內容差異）找出變動區域，接著以 dirty-rectangle 最佳化重畫。後者只繪製變動區域。當終端機畫面不如預期，想不用這兩項最佳化來檢查時，設定 `AGY_CLI_DISABLE_ESCAPE_SEQUENCE_OPTIMIZATIONS`。這會在這次啟動略過兩者。⟦這像修補壁畫，先核對新舊草稿找出變色格子，再補畫那些格子；這個開關容許不走這套修補流程。⟧
body.en: Antigravity's renderer (the part that draws text in the terminal) uses two optimizations. It first uses diffing optimization (comparing old and new content) to find changed areas, then uses dirty-rectangle optimization to redraw them. The latter redraws only changed areas. When terminal output does not look right and you want to check it without either optimization, set `AGY_CLI_DISABLE_ESCAPE_SEQUENCE_OPTIMIZATIONS`. This bypasses both for that launch. ⟦It is like restoring a mural by comparing the old and new sketches to find changed tiles, then repainting those tiles; this switch allows that restoration routine to be bypassed.⟧

items.original: Added `AGY_CLI_DISABLE_ESCAPE_SEQUENCE_OPTIMIZATIONS` to bypass the renderer's dirty-rectangle and diffing optimizations.
